name: Saffron Gym (Marsh Badge Duel)
summary: With Silph Co. saved, the Rocket grunt guarding Saffron Gym flees. Enter the psychic sanctum and navigate its warp-tile maze. When challenging Sabrina, select your 4 designated Pokémon from your active party when prompted to begin the 4v4 Marsh Badge battle.

items.name: Marsh Badge
items.method: Awarded by Gym Leader Sabrina upon defeat (ensures Pokémon obedience up to Lv. 70)

items.name: TM03 Psyshock
items.method: Reward from Gym Leader Sabrina after winning the Marsh Badge duel
